messages:
tara: Heads-up, I'm pausing the change window. CI integration uploader step is failing with partial multipart writes, deploybot keeps retrying and stalling the promote.

kevin: Can you drop the exact uploader error?

tara: Paste below from bk-agent-9 at ~04:02 UTC:
```
[artifact-uploader] upload chunk 2/4 failed: write: unexpected EOF
WARN 2026-03-23T04:02:11Z retrying chunk upload (attempt 4)
ERROR 2026-03-23T04:02:15Z upload aborted: Unexpected EOF while reading multipart body
```

jamie: That looks like a runner-side network/disk flush or an S3 side 500. Any recent runner GC events?

infra-bot: MONITOR: eu-west-runner-pool GC spike detected at 04:00 UTC (10x baseline), reclaimed ephemeral volumes: 6.

kevin: Yep, eu-west GC spike matches. We've had occasional aggressive eviction from the cleanup job after a recent config change.

tara: Options: 1) wait and retry (may miss change window), 2) pin last known good artifact and manual-promote, 3) rollback if canary flakes. Thoughts?

jamie: If we need to keep the window, pin+promote. We can add a short release-note explaining it's a pin for uploader flakiness and follow up infra ticket.

kevin: Agreed. What's the last good digest?

tara: Promoted artifact from commit 1769550000, image sha256:fa57c9b2d4e3. I can manual-promote if no objections.

deploy-bot: ACTION NEEDED: manual-promote requires org-owner approval or the --override flag. Command: `deploybot manual-promote --pin 1769550000 --reason "ci uploader EOF"`.

jamie: I'll +1. Also please open infra issue for uploader resilience and consider smaller chunk sizes for uploads.

kevin: I'll file infra#4620: "multipart uploader EOF under runner GC; consider retry backoff and chunk size tuning". Assigning to @infra-team.

tara: Running manual promote now: `deploybot manual-promote --pin 1769550000 --author @tara`

buildkite-bot: PROMOTE: canary rollout started for release 2026.03.23-pin-hotfix (pinned sha256:fa57c9b2d4e3).

deploy-bot: PROMOTE OK: canary healthy (10/10 checks) after 8m. Monitoring window 15m.

jamie: Draft release note line: "Hotfix: pinned release to previously promoted artifact (sha256:fa57c9b2d4e3) due to intermittent multipart uploader EOF during CI; follow-up infra investigation opened (infra#4620)."

tara: Added release note and CI postmortem stub. Also temporarily disabled aggressive runner GC in eu-west for the next 30m to avoid further upload interruptions.

kevin: Thanks. After change window, let's revert the GC tweak and roll a small uploader change that reduces chunk size and adds stronger EOF handling.

tara: Agreed. Will keep the window open and call for rollback if canary metrics degrade. Thanks all :thumbsup:
